## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young man with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets. He has a snubbed nose and a single dimple in one of his cheeks that gives him a sweet, uneven appearance when he chuckles.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Robin Farrow is an inquisitive, curious child whose constant questioning can be overwhelming to others. Naturally mischievous and enthusiastic, he works with more zeal than judgment, pulling faces, tormenting cats, and frequently engaging in or planning misbehavior. Although he is somewhat careless and prone to forgetting, his troubles are easily healed with plum jam. His ambitions include reaching one hundred years of age and becoming a shopkeeper who stocks large quantities of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 IX A Question of Color P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +8 more_

## History

As an energetic, highly mischievous newly orphaned twin, Robin Farrow is brought by [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) alongside his sister [Lucy](../character/lucy.md). He quickly establishes a habit of playing pranks—such as dropping caterpillars, putting a toad under Thirza's pillow, enticing [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) into a wet pigpen, and locking her in a toolhouse—before tearfully confessing to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that he had not understood that lying was wrong. Though disciplined with bedtime punishments, Robin continues his comedic antics, including accidentally ruining lemon pies and shattering a borrowed platter down the stairs. He struggles with feelings of jealousy when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) pays attention to others, but he remains deeply attached to her. Following the death of his father [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md), a trust fund is left so that he and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) can remain permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). As he grows, Robin faces moral dilemmas such as resisting bad language, struggling under Mrs. Sowerby's strict oversight, and eventually confessing to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after skipping Sunday School and telling lies. Despite his frequent misbehavior and curiosity about life, death, and marriage, Robin maintains a loving relationship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), turning to her for comfort, guidance, and forgiveness whenever his conscience troubles him.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +43 more_

## Quotes

> "You do not seem like the kind of lady who would lash a small boy simply because he was unable to stay motionless. Did you not find staying motionless terribly difficult when you were merely as old as I am?"
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "Thirza did the laundry yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scrubbed my skin using hard soap on the funeral day. For a single week, that suffices. Being so exceedingly clean seems pointless to me. Staying dirty is far more comfortable."
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "However, the caterpillar was so amazingly large . . . I grabbed him from the church steps right as we entered. Wasting him appeared to be a shame. Also, tell me, was it not amusing listening to that girl scream?"
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> "I only carried it out for amusement. Events have been extraordinarily quiet in this place for such a long time that I believed scaring you people immensely would prove entertaining. Indeed, it turned out to be so."
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “Why?” asked Robin, making himself comfortable and gazing upward with a tear-streaked, probing countenance. “Why is whopper not as good as falsehood? I want to know. It is an equally large word.”
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

## Relationships

### [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--robin-farrow.md)

[Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is Robin's twin sister, who came to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) with him after they were orphaned. Robin frequently targets her with energetic pranks and mischief, such as tricking her into jumping into a pigpen, luring her outside under a water pump, and locking her inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +20 more_

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--robin-farrow.md)

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) acts as a young friend and affectionate guardian to Robin, holding authority over him while managing his behavioral issues. Though Robin occasionally pushes back against rules and argues with her, she comforts him during breakdowns, helps guide his upbringing, and puts him to bed.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +14 more_

### [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/pettifer--robin-farrow.md)

Robin holds Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) in admiration and acts as a friend to him, helping out by hauling dulse. A source of friction between them occurred when Robin locked his sister [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)_

- Friend of — assisting him with hauling dulse and admiring him  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)</sub>

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/robin-farrow--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is Robin's third cousin once removed who took him in as a guardian after he was orphaned. She maintains household authority and discipline over Robin, frequently dealing with his mischievous antics—such as finding a toad Robin hid under her pillow—and punishing his trickery by sending him to bed without dinner.
